title: Butterfly wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Upper left wing -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='40' rx='22' ry='18' fill='#FF8C42' transform='rotate(-20 28 40)'/>
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='38' rx='14' ry='10' fill='#FFB347' transform='rotate(-20 26 38)'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='36' r='4' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <!-- Upper right wing -->
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='40' rx='22' ry='18' fill='#FF8C42' transform='rotate(20 72 40)'/>
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='38' rx='14' ry='10' fill='#FFB347' transform='rotate(20 74 38)'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='36' r='4' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <!-- Lower left wing -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='62' rx='16' ry='13' fill='#FF6B9D' transform='rotate(15 32 62)'/>
  <ellipse cx='31' cy='61' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#FFA6C9' transform='rotate(15 31 61)'/>
  <!-- Lower right wing -->
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='62' rx='16' ry='13' fill='#FF6B9D' transform='rotate(-15 68 62)'/>
  <ellipse cx='69' cy='61' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#FFA6C9' transform='rotate(-15 69 61)'/>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='5' ry='18' fill='#5B2D8E'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='36' r='6' fill='#7B4DC0'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='47' cy='35' r='2' fill='#E0F7FF'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='35' r='2' fill='#E0F7FF'/>
  <circle cx='47' cy='35' r='1' fill='#2D1B69'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='35' r='1' fill='#2D1B69'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M47 38 Q50 41 53 38' stroke='#E0F7FF' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Antennae -->
  <path d='M47 31 Q42 22 38 18' stroke='#C77DFF' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='17' r='2.5' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <path d='M53 31 Q58 22 62 18' stroke='#C77DFF' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='17' r='2.5' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <!-- Party hat -->
  <polygon points='50,14 40,30 60,30' fill='#00E5FF'/>
  <polygon points='50,18 43,30 57,30' fill='#FFE74C'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='13' r='3' fill='#FF4D6D'/>
  <!-- Hat stripes -->
  <line x1='45' y1='24' x2='55' y2='24' stroke='#FF4D6D' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='43' y1='28' x2='57' y2='28' stroke='#00E5FF' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Hat brim -->
  <rect x='38' y='29' width='24' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#FF4D6D'/>
</svg>
